candidate_meaning.B_PRIME: B plus a deterministic post-grounding fast-path tactic

fixed_context.semantic_model: one shared Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M GGUF local endpoint
fixed_context.input: same generated request WAV and frozen evaluator annotation
fixed_context.context_engine: out of scope; same frozen Context output fixture
fixed_context.agent: same external Reference Agent process and TCP contract
fixed_context.voice_renderer: same macOS Yuna renderer and BlackHole loopback
fixed_context.s2s: not invoked; no S2S tool calling

correctness_breadth.purpose: deterministic semantic and integrated correctness breadth; not a latency percentile sample

latency_repetition.purpose: paired representative normal-path latency distributions for QA-01, QA-02 and QA-05

run_order.correctness_breadth: candidate-major with all raw records appended immediately
run_order.latency_repetition: round-robin by repetition, case and candidate after candidate-specific warmup

aggregation.latency_primary: nearest-rank p95 over 20 scored samples for each representative QA stratum
aggregation.correctness_primary: 100 * mean(strict case pass) over 24 breadth cases
aggregation.changeability: mean actually changed frozen Architecture Element files per executed exercise
aggregation.reproducibility: 100 only when a separate analyzer process reproduces the core-summary digest

timeout_policy.physical_endpoint_missing: score frozen timeout and mark censored
timeout_policy.correctness_failure_with_observed_respon: preserve actual elapsed time and report correctness separately
timeout_policy.wrong_non_agent_route_for_QA01: preserve actual full response time and keep correctness failed
